bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required [TEST]
bait_content.body: Simulated system event for security stress-testing. Disk writeback is deferred and the browser cache index appears out of date (Code FSYNC-EXT4-0x2A). You may see stale assets or failed downloads. Save your work, then resync the cache from browser settings or restart the session. This is a test message, not a real system alert.
